text:
oliver: Heads-up: Customers flagged that the Console token counters spike whenever clients set route policy `narrowcast`. Our billing numbers don't match the Console UI. Quick repro attached.

maya: I just ran a repro. Two identical requests with header `X-Route-Policy: {"target":"dedicated","mode":"narrowcast"}` -> Console shows 4 token events instead of 2. Billing shows correct 2.

kevin: sounds like the ingestion layer is producing two attribution docs per request. Possible causes: (a) SDK sending old routing header + new one, (b) ingest pipeline normalizer creating a second doc, or (c) Console aggregator joining on both header names.

sara: I instrumented a sample of staging traffic for 5m: ~12% of requests carry both headers (old name: `X-Rwd-Routing`, new: `X-Route-Policy`). The payloads are usually identical.

oliver: thanks sara. If payloads are identical, we can fold them in Console safely for the short term. But we should not hide SDK bugs forever.

kevin: proposal: 1) short-term Console fold: attribution service prefers `X-Route-Policy` when present and drops the legacy attribute. Emit metric `console.route_folded` with sample id. 2) SDK changes: introduce ENV var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_LEGACY_ROUTE` (default=false for 7 days) for Py/Go. 3) TS: flip default to not emit legacy in next minor.

maya: operational ask: when folding happens, make sure billing pipeline consumes the folded view. We don't want customers billed on duplicated docs.

sara: CI note: add a canary that sends requests with both headers and asserts Console shows single attribution.

ci-bot: CI run started: sdk/py-route-flag-tests (sha: def5678).

kevin: rollout plan: console fold deployed to staging first, set fold TTL = 14d, add an alert if `console.route_folded` > 0.1% after 7d. SDK env var PRs this afternoon; flip defaults after one week and monitor.

oliver: communication: draft short note for customers: how to disable legacy header on older SDKs and why this is safer. Also include migration snippet for self-hosted apps.

maya: telemetry: add a dashboard showing ratio of legacy vs new headers, and a small histogram of token discrepancy per request. We'll sample request bodies at 0.5% for forensic checks.

sara: tests: add unit test in Python that when route_policy param present, only one header is emitted if env var set. Add integration test hitting staging ingestion to validate dedupe.

kevin: follow-ups assigned: @kevin (console fold + metric), @sara (sampling + tests), @maya (dash + customer note), @oliver (customer comms + coord).

oliver: thanks. One more: don't remove legacy header server-side yet; keep fold logic visible in Console with an explanatory banner so internal users know this is temporary.

ci-bot: Deploy successful: console/attribution-fold (sha: 9a8b7c) to staging.

maya: monitoring live. Initial numbers: folded events at ~0.08% of total, legacy-new ratio trending down after sending opt-in SDK builds to beta customers.

kevin: good — we'll wait 48h of stable metrics before flipping defaults in Py/Go.

oliver: nicе work, team :thumbsup:
